name: Richard Plastics Co
old_description: Richard Plastics Co. is a state of the art custom injection molding facility
about:
Richard Plastics Co. has operated from Laurel, Mississippi since 1948, when it was founded to supply custom injection-molded thermoplastic parts at affordable prices. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The 22,700-square-foot facility houses computer-controlled Milacron molding machines that run small to medium production runs, from a few hundred parts up to hundreds of thousands. In-house capabilities include custom injection molding of thermoplastics, on-site mold building and repair through a comprehensive toolroom, and secondary operations such as assembly, hot stamping, heat transfer, machining, and pad printing.

The molder serves customers in furniture, water-valve, and precision military-component sectors, working from design sketches through finished parts. Its toolroom can refine existing mold designs or develop new ones to improve cost efficiency.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and a quality system aimed at defect-free parts, citing decades-long customer relationships as evidence of its reliability.
